levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة

notes: «- وهو ابن إبراهيم بن سعد -» is an editor's gloss and is left out; «أبي» is Yaqub's father, a relation link with no name
The three co-transmitters at the first level all narrate from Yaqub; «وألفاظهم متقاربة» is a remark on wording, not a route
Abu Sa'id is the Companion whose words («حدثنا رسول الله») are the saying
